name: live-panel-manager-split
brief:
## Goal
Restructure the desktop UI's two sidebars around Konrad's mental model: LEFT = what he steers, RIGHT = what the selected group is doing. Right now manager-level entries (project/goal runs) show up in the right Live panel mixed across projects — he finds that confusing and wants it fixed.

## The model (Konrad's words, 2026-08-05)
- LEFT rail: his conversations as today, PLUS a managers section — exactly one entry per active project/goal ('one manager basically per project or goal'). Each manager entry shows the group's aggregate token usage/spend and coarse progress (done/total tasks, status). Raw project-task runs must still NEVER appear as individual chats in the rail (the existing project_tasks.run_id exclusion in forge-control/src/db/runs.ts listRuns/searchRuns stays).
- RIGHT Live panel: ONLY the workers of the selected manager's group — that project's architect/planner/builder/reviewer runs and their sub-agents (parent_run_id children), each with per-worker token usage. Never show other projects' manager-level entries there. When no manager is selected, default to the most recently active project's group; provide an obvious way to switch.

## Where things live
- Web: /opt/forge-ai-os/forge-control-web (Next 15 + React 19, pm2 forge-control-web). Live panel components: app/desktop/live/AgentActivity.tsx + agentsApi.ts. Left rail: grep the chat rail components under app/desktop/. Design tokens: app/tokens.ts (CSS variables — both themes must keep working; zero hardcoded colors).
- API: /opt/forge-ai-os/forge-control (Hono :7700, tsx). Projects + tasks: src/routes/projects.ts, src/db/projects.ts (see /board and listActiveTasks). Runs: src/db/runs.ts, src/routes/chat.ts, src/routes/live.ts. Token/spend accounting: src/routes/spend.ts, src/routes/usage.ts and wherever runs store usage — read them to find the real source of truth; if no per-run token rollup exists, add an efficient aggregate endpoint (e.g. GET /api/projects with per-project token/cost rollup, and per-run usage in the group feed). No N+1 queries; aggregate in SQL.

## Definition of done
- Left rail shows a managers section: one card per active/blocked project (name, status, done/total tasks, aggregate tokens or EUR spend). Clicking selects that group. Done/cancelled projects drop off (or collapse under a history toggle).
- Right Live panel shows only the selected group's worker runs + their sub-agents, with per-worker token usage; nothing manager-level from other groups. Non-project standalone runs (e.g. Konrad's own chats) never pollute the Live panel.
- Existing chat behavior in the rail is unchanged for conversations.
- npx tsc --noEmit clean in both repos; npm run build passes in forge-control-web.

## Quality bar
Reviewer must run tsc in both repos, the web build, and curl the new/changed API endpoints against :7700 verifying real JSON (including the token rollup numbers being non-zero for a project that has runs). Grep the touched components for hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl — tokens only. Verify both themes.

## Constraints / hard rules
- ANOTHER PROJECT IS RUNNING TONIGHT in a parallel worktree touching the Files experience: do NOT touch FileExplorerPanel*, forge-control/src/routes/files.ts, or anything Files-specific — you would create merge conflicts. If your change seems to require it, stop and say so in your final message instead.
- You MAY edit the desktop shell (DesktopApp.tsx, app/desktop/live/) — it is the scope of this project — but keep diffs surgical.
- Design tokens only. pnpm repos: NODE_ENV=development pnpm add X --prod=false. NEVER restart or touch forge-executor; restarting forge-control and forge-control-web is allowed.

## Deployment (final phase, only after the reviewer's PASS)
1. In /opt/forge-ai-os (live checkout): if main has moved since you branched (the Files project may have merged), first merge main INTO your work branch, re-run tsc + build there, then merge your branch to main. If conflicts arise at any point, STOP, leave the branch, and report exactly which files conflict.
2. Rebuild forge-control-web and pm2 restart forge-control-web; restart forge-control if API files changed. NEVER forge-executor.
3. Verify pm2 online, GET :7700/api/health ok, web serves 200. Summarize what changed in your final message.
